metadata.sourceHashScope: tracked apps/console, services/api, packages/contracts, package manifest and lockfile

privacy.note: Harness rejects unapproved queries before dispatch; a boundary stop is counted separately from actual exposure.

limitations: Small purposive nonrepresentative sample; no production accuracy estimate.
Abstention, missing verdict and unrun case are separate; none is a factual pass.
Definitive precision is conditional on a definitive output; coverage denominator is all eight eligible claims.
Citation selection and provider source assessments are observations, not independent citation relevance validation.
Observed terminal delivery is not a factual-accuracy pass; review every abstention and definitive citation.

24,000 tokens per pending/unknown Jev attempt is an uncertainty allowance, not a tokenizer-derived upper bound. Any unknown completed Jev usage blocks subsequent provider dispatch. Actual usage can exceed a reservation before the harness can stop.
A dispatch_reserved checkpoint records an allowance before fetch is called; interruption leaves dispatch uncertain. Final actual attempt counts include only dispatched attempts.
Known costs are partial when any attempt has unknown cost. No prices are invented.
No held-out bodies, raw private text, provider prompts, session credentials or keys are retained. Native/iOS/ASR paths are untested.
Independent fresh-set construction preceded this source freeze. The evaluator knows earlier public aggregate outcomes and high-level fix descriptions; no new implementation diffs/docs were read.
One timeout has no factual verdict. Seven factual result events do not mean eight factual judgments completed.
The sole run is preserved, including one operational pipeline error and the distinct post-execution wrapper publication failure.

citations.independentReviewMethod: Manual reasoning over actual public HTTPS GET page text/PDF text and stored checked proposition/verdict; no model-as-judge pipeline invocation or scoring rerun. All six exact selected URLs attempted without substitution.
independentReviewLimitations: One HTTP-200 application error page prevents source-content and source-quality verification for that selected reference.
One secondary source has a stale unrelated future-date statement; historical claim is directly supported.
Single post-run retrieval records current access, not page accessibility at runner retrieval time.
Source relevance and direct statement do not imply original authoritative provenance; four sources are secondary explanations.
Reviewer retrieval is not evidence that a user deliberately opened any citation.
No broad search for unselected opposing evidence; no replacement of failed citations.

latency.definition: Case receipt-to-terminal duration, including service timeout; quantiles use nearest rank. Controls and factual inputs have separate denominators.

costObservation.note: Known provider-reported charges only; unknown cost is not zero. Aborted contents cost remains unknown.

records.retryObservation: No whole-case retry or aborted-contents retry observed; attempt receipts do not separately classify planned refinement calls versus retries.
records.denominatorEffect: Retained among all eight eligible facts as one no-verdict, not an abstention or factual pass.

publicationRecovery.reason: Prepared public directory already existed; original wrapper used nonrecursive mkdir.
publicationRecovery.recoveryMethod: Separate artifact-only post-processing; no implementation import, provider call, source change or harness rerun.

publicDisclosure: Aggregate-only. Bodies, labels, queries and identifying source URLs stay private. Third campaign remains separate; no pooling, replacement or causal comparison with either earlier campaign.
